name: WhatSThis_11
short_caption: The robot extends its right arm forward with an open palm as if presenting or questioning an object.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral posture, the robot smoothly lifts its right arm forward and slightly to the side, rotating its wrist so the hand opens palm-upward. It holds this gentle offering or questioning posture briefly with its fingers slightly spread, while its head remains still and forward-facing. Finally, it brings the right arm down in a controlled manner, returning to the neutral resting pose.
safety_notes: The right arm extends directly forward. Ensure there are no obstacles or people directly in front of the robot within arm's reach.
